introduction: The 5G Core Network (5G-CN) is the "brain" of the mobile network, running on cloud-native software. It handles authentication, data routing, security, and session management. This foundational backbone of the 5G system, relies on Service-Based Architecture (SBA). Where the SBA architecture elements are modular, reusable, cloud-native "Network Functions" (NFs), that communicate via APIs. It separates the control plane (decisions and signaling) from the user plane (data traffic handling), allowing for better resource routing and latency reduction

UG: The 5G Core Network Virtual Laboratory is designed for learners interested in 5G mobile communication, wireless networks, computer networks, network virtualization, and next-generation communication systems.
PG: The 5G Core Network Virtual Laboratory is designed for learners interested in 5G mobile communication, wireless networks, computer networks, network virtualization, and next-generation communication systems.

objective:
The 5G Core Network Virtual Lab adopts a constructivist pedagogical approach, fostering active learning by integrating theoretical foundations with experiential practice to achieve higher-order cognitive outcome. Students gain deep comprehension of 5G architecture, protocols (e.g., NGAP, NAS, SBI per 3GPP). Key objectives include:
  • Conceptual Mastery: Understand core concepts via visualized information flows and dashboards.
  • Skill Development: Apply hands-on configuration, troubleshooting, and performance analysis.
  • Study the principles of Service-Based Architecture (SBA).
  • Understand the roles and interactions of major 5G Network Functions.
  • Understand the communication and data exchange between the UE, gNB, and 5G Core Network, and perform bandwidth and latency measurements to evaluate the performance of the 5G network.
  • Critical Thinking: Evaluate real-world scenarios and innovate solutions via negative testing.
  • Transferable Competence: Bridge academia-industry gap, enabling independent real-lab execution and lifelong 5G proficiency.
